generationInputs.prompt: A soft, polished digital painting depicts two emoji figures rendered with a cool-toned palette of light blues, grays, and whites. The emoji on the left displays a shocked expression, featuring wide, round light blue eyes with dark gray pupils looking slightly upward and to the right. Its mouth is open in an "O" shape, and a small, light blue hand extends to touch its lower lip or chin. Two small, light gray circles suggest a blush on its cheeks. Positioned slightly lower and to the right, the second emoji resembles two rounded light blue humps suggesting buttocks, with a small, horizontal dark gray oval centrally located on the upper portion. Below this, a single, small, light gray teardrop is depicted. Both emoji figures have a glossy, soft sheen with diffused lighting, implying a light source from above, and faint, blurry reflections along their bottom edges on a subtle light gray gradient background.
